verdict.rationale: Gemini's own docs describe function calling: the model decides when to call specific functions and supplies the parameters to execute actions. The Interactions API shows function calls in a chronological steps array, which supports a multi-step agent loop. The evidence shows the core capability but does not document typed tool declarations, parallel calls, or how faithful the calls are in practice. missing for 10: explicit typed/schema-based tool declaration docs, documented parallel function calling, explicit multi-turn agent-loop guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of call reliability

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on faithful function/tool calling — typed tool definitions, parallel and multi-step calls — documented well enough to run an agent loop on this model

citations.quote: Function calling lets you connect models to external tools and APIs. Instead of generating text responses, the model determines when to call specific functions and provides the necessary parameters to execute real-world actions.
dedicated steps that appear chronologically alongside function calls, user inputs or model outputs in the `steps` array
